operations.description: Pan a north-up camera (maps-core FlatRasterRuntime.pan_by_pixels, 32 frames of (37, -23) CSS px from 0,0 at zoom 5, 800x600 viewport) over one unchanged GPU-retained application point group (#155), after its first draw. Each frame derives the RetainedView from the real maps-core frame plan, places the group and packs its frame uniforms like prepare_retained_point_draws. Oracle first: every checked point that maps-core projects into the viewport is drawn within 0.05 px of that projection by a packed frame uniform applied to its mirrored GPU instance, with its current paint (all points in the last frame, about 1,000 per earlier frame).

staticFeatures.description: retained points in the group, deterministic within longitude -30..30 and latitude -20..20

metrics.name: prepared-coordinates
metrics.notes: Points lowered from longitude/latitude into f64 Web Mercator (RetainedPointCounters.prepared). Data changes only; zero on camera frames.

metrics.name: encoded-instances
metrics.notes: Points encoded as f32 anchor offsets into GPU instances (RetainedPointCounters.encoded). Zero on ordinary camera frames: only the frame uniform moves.

metrics.name: instance-upload-bytes
metrics.notes: Instance bytes written to the retained GPU buffer (RetainedPointCounters.upload_bytes), cross-checked against the executed uploads.

metrics.name: instance-rebuilds
metrics.notes: Full instance-buffer rebuilds (RetainedPointCounters.rebases): every rebuild is a counted local-frame rebase around a new anchor. None at ordinary zooms; see retained-points-camera-deep-pan-rebase.

metrics.name: instance-write-calls
metrics.notes: GPU instance-buffer write calls executed by the backend for this phase.

metrics.name: frame-uniform-writes
metrics.notes: Frame uniforms written: one per drawn world copy per camera frame (one copy at these zooms), at WebGPU's default 256-byte dynamic-offset stride.

metrics.name: frame-uniform-bytes
metrics.notes: Frame uniforms written: one per drawn world copy per camera frame (one copy at these zooms), at WebGPU's default 256-byte dynamic-offset stride.

operations.description: Pan at zoom 15 (64 frames of 2,000 CSS px) over an unchanged retained point group laid out along the path, so the camera travels past the 32,768 px rebase distance (REBASE_DISTANCE_PX) three times. Explicit local-frame rebases are allowed, must be counted and are bounded by camera travel, not by frames or features: each rebase re-encodes the group once, so its upload is linear in features while the rebase count stays constant. Same projection oracle, with every point checked on each rebase frame.

staticFeatures.description: retained points in a band along the pan path

metrics.name: instance-rebuilds
metrics.notes: Counted local-frame rebases: floor(64 / (floor(32768 / 2000) + 1)) = 3 for this travel, at every size. A per-frame rebuild would be 64.

metrics.name: instance-write-calls
metrics.notes: One full buffer replacement per rebase.

metrics.name: prepared-coordinates
metrics.notes: No re-lowering from longitude/latitude: rebases re-encode from the retained f64 world coordinates.

metrics.name: encoded-instances
metrics.notes: Exactly rebases x features: a rebase re-encodes the group once. Declared linear in features; the constant rebase count is what keeps camera work bounded.

metrics.name: instance-upload-bytes
metrics.notes: Exactly rebases x features x 48 bytes.

metrics.name: frame-uniform-writes
metrics.notes: Frame uniforms written: one per drawn world copy per camera frame (one copy at these zooms), at WebGPU's default 256-byte dynamic-offset stride.

metrics.name: frame-uniform-bytes

operations.description: Update changed points of a drawn retained group in place (RetainedPointState.update behind updateRetainedPoints: new position 0.5 degrees east and 0.25 degrees south, new paint), spread across the group so no two are adjacent, then draw one camera frame. Oracle: in that frame every point that maps-core projects into the viewport, changed or not, is drawn at its current position with its current paint.

metrics.name: prepared-coordinates
metrics.notes: Only the changed points are lowered (exactly changedFeatures).

metrics.name: encoded-instances
metrics.notes: Only the changed points are re-encoded, around the group's current anchor (exactly changedFeatures).

metrics.name: instance-upload-bytes
metrics.notes: Exactly changedFeatures x 48 bytes written in place.

metrics.name: instance-write-calls
metrics.notes: One write per contiguous run of changed points; non-adjacent here, so exactly changedFeatures.

metrics.name: instance-rebuilds
metrics.notes: The update and the following camera frame never rebuild the group.

metrics.name: unrelated-instances-written
metrics.notes: Instance slots rewritten in the mirrored GPU buffer that do not belong to a changed point.

metrics.name: bridge-bytes
metrics.notes: Argument bytes of the updateRetainedPoints call (u32 index, f64 longitude/latitude, 10 f32 paint values per changed point = 60 bytes).

metrics.name: frame-uniform-writes
metrics.notes: Frame uniforms written: one per drawn world copy per camera frame (one copy at these zooms), at WebGPU's default 256-byte dynamic-offset stride.

metrics.name: frame-uniform-bytes
metrics.notes: Frame uniforms written: one per drawn world copy per camera frame (one copy at these zooms), at WebGPU's default 256-byte dynamic-offset stride.

operations.description: Replace a drawn retained group with a different dataset of the same size (RetainedPointState.prepare behind setRetainedPoints), then draw one camera frame. Legitimate O(N) work, declared linear, in contrast to the constant camera operations. Same projection oracle over every point.

metrics.name: prepared-coordinates
metrics.notes: Every new point is lowered once (exactly features).

metrics.name: encoded-instances
metrics.notes: Encoded once on the first draw of the new data (exactly features).

metrics.name: instance-upload-bytes
metrics.notes: Exactly features x 48 bytes.

metrics.name: bridge-bytes
metrics.notes: Argument bytes of the setRetainedPoints call (56 bytes per point).

metrics.name: instance-rebuilds
metrics.notes: One full build for the new data.

metrics.name: instance-write-calls
metrics.notes: One buffer replacement.

operations.description: Comparison role, not a Maps failure: the screen-projected application path that the retained points replace (the path before #155, still the fallback where retention is unavailable). For 8 pan frames, every point is projected through maps-core FlatRasterRuntime.project_screen_batch, packed as one 48-byte circle record and re-encoded by prepare_application_geometry into one GPU circle instance. Oracle: a packed circle centre equals the maps-core projection.
operations.publicContract: maps-wasm prepare_application_geometry (packed application circles behind renderPacked)

metrics.name: projected-coordinates
metrics.notes: Exactly frames x features: this is the per-camera O(N) work the retained operations must not show.

metrics.name: circle-bridge-bytes
metrics.notes: Packed circle records sent per frame: exactly frames x features x 48 bytes.

metrics.name: circle-upload-bytes
metrics.notes: Circle instance bytes re-encoded for upload per frame (56 bytes per circle).
